package {{package}};

import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.command.Command;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter;
import org.bukkit.entity.Entity;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeSet;

/** Parses, checks and tab-completes the typed sub commands of one command. Generated by ModStudio. */
public final class CommandTree implements CommandExecutor, TabCompleter {
    public record Arg(String name, String type, boolean literal, Double min, Double max, List<String> choices) {
        int width() {
            return type.equals("blockpos") ? 3 : 1;
        }
    }

    public record Branch(List<Arg> args, String function, int permission, String usage) {
    }

    private static final String MODID = "{{modid}}";
    private static final boolean MACROS = {{macros}};
    private static final boolean FOLIA = {{folia}};
    private static final List<String> SELECTORS = List.of("@a", "@p", "@r", "@s", "@e");

    private final String base;
    private final int basePermission;
    private final List<Branch> branches;

    /** @param base function for the command without arguments, or null when it needs a sub command. */
    public CommandTree(String base, int basePermission, List<Branch> branches) {
        this.base = base;
        this.basePermission = basePermission;
        this.branches = branches;
    }

    private static boolean allowed(CommandSender sender, int permission) {
        return permission <= 0 || sender.isOp() || !(sender instanceof Player);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onCommand(CommandSender sender, Command command, String label, String[] raw) {
        List<String> tokens = tokenize(String.join(" ", raw));
        if (tokens.isEmpty() && base != null) {
            if (!allowed(sender, basePermission)) {
                sender.sendMessage("§cYou do not have permission to use this command.");
                return true;
            }
            run(sender, base, new LinkedHashMap<>());
            return true;
        }
        for (Branch b : branches) {
            Map<Arg, String> values = match(sender, b, tokens);
            if (values == null) continue;
            if (!allowed(sender, b.permission())) {
                sender.sendMessage("§cYou do not have permission to use this command.");
                return true;
            }
            run(sender, b.function(), values);
            return true;
        }
        sender.sendMessage("§cUsage:");
        List<String> seen = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Branch b : branches) {
            if (!allowed(sender, b.permission()) || seen.contains(b.usage())) continue;
            seen.add(b.usage());
            sender.sendMessage("§7  /" + label + " " + b.usage());
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static List<String> tokenize(String s) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();
        boolean quoted = false, any = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '"') {
                quoted = !quoted;
                any = true;
            } else if (c == ' ' && !quoted) {
                if (any || cur.length() > 0) out.add(cur.toString());
                cur.setLength(0);
                any = false;
            } else {
                cur.append(c);
            }
        }
        if (any || cur.length() > 0) out.add(cur.toString());
        return out;
    }

    private static Map<Arg, String> match(CommandSender sender, Branch b, List<String> tokens) {
        Map<Arg, String> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        int i = 0;
        for (Arg a : b.args()) {
            if (a.type().equals("text")) {
                if (i >= tokens.size()) return null;
                out.put(a, quote(String.join(" ", tokens.subList(i, tokens.size()))));
                i = tokens.size();
                continue;
            }
            if (i + a.width() > tokens.size()) return null;
            if (a.type().equals("blockpos")) {
                List<String> c = tokens.subList(i, i + 3);
                for (String x : c) if (!coordinate(x)) return null;
                out.put(a, quote(String.join(" ", c)));
                i += 3;
                continue;
            }
            String v = value(sender, a, tokens.get(i++));
            if (v == null) return null;
            if (!a.literal()) out.put(a, v);
        }
        return i == tokens.size() ? out : null;
    }

    private static boolean coordinate(String s) {
        String n = s.startsWith("~") || s.startsWith("^") ? s.substring(1) : s;
        if (n.isEmpty()) return true;
        try {
            Double.parseDouble(n);
            return true;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static String value(CommandSender sender, Arg a, String t) {
        switch (a.type()) {
            case "literal":
                return t.equalsIgnoreCase(a.name()) ? "" : null;
            case "int":
            case "double": {
                double d;
                try {
                    d = a.type().equals("int") ? Long.parseLong(t) : Double.parseDouble(t);
                } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                    return null;
                }
                if (a.min() != null && d < a.min()) return null;
                if (a.max() != null && d > a.max()) return null;
                if (a.type().equals("int")) return Long.toString((long) d);
                return d + "d";
            }
            case "bool":
                return t.equalsIgnoreCase("true") ? "true" : t.equalsIgnoreCase("false") ? "false" : null;
            case "player":
            case "players":
            case "entity":
            case "entities": {
                boolean single = a.type().equals("player") || a.type().equals("entity");
                boolean playersOnly = a.type().startsWith("player");
                if (t.startsWith("@")) {
                    try {
                        List<Entity> found = Bukkit.selectEntities(sender, t);
                        if (found.isEmpty() || (single && found.size() > 1)) return null;
                        if (playersOnly && found.stream().anyMatch(e -> !(e instanceof Player))) return null;
                    } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                    return quote(t);
                }
                if (Bukkit.getPlayerExact(t) == null) return null;
                return quote(t);
            }
            case "item":
            case "block": {
                String id = t.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (id.startsWith(MODID + ":")) return quote(id);
                Material m = Material.matchMaterial(id);
                if (m == null || (a.type().equals("block") ? !m.isBlock() : !m.isItem())) return null;
                return quote(m.getKey().toString());
            }
            case "choice":
                for (String c : a.choices()) if (c.equalsIgnoreCase(t)) return quote(c);
                return null;
            default:
                return quote(t);
        }
    }

    private static String quote(String s) {
        return "\"" + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\"";
    }

    private static void run(CommandSender sender, String function, Map<Arg, String> values) {
        StringBuilder nbt = new StringBuilder("{");
        List<String> scores = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<Arg, String> e : values.entrySet()) {
            if (nbt.length() > 1) nbt.append(',');
            nbt.append(e.getKey().name()).append(':').append(e.getValue());
            if (e.getKey().type().equals("int")) scores.add("scoreboard players set $" + e.getKey().name() + " " + MODID + ".args " + e.getValue());
        }
        nbt.append('}');
        Runnable dispatch = () -> {
            CommandSender console = Bukkit.getConsoleSender();
            Bukkit.dispatchCommand(console, "data modify storage " + MODID + ":args a set value " + nbt);
            for (String s : scores) Bukkit.dispatchCommand(console, s);
            String fn = "function " + MODID + ":" + function + (MACROS ? " with storage " + MODID + ":args a" : "");
            if (sender instanceof Entity entity) Bukkit.dispatchCommand(console, "execute as " + entity.getUniqueId() + " at @s run " + fn);
            else Bukkit.dispatchCommand(console, fn);
        };
        if (FOLIA) Bukkit.getGlobalRegionScheduler().execute(org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin.getProvidingPlugin(CommandTree.class), dispatch);
        else dispatch.run();
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> onTabComplete(CommandSender sender, Command command, String alias, String[] raw) {
        int index = raw.length - 1;
        String prefix = index < 0 ? "" : raw[index].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        TreeSet<String> out = new TreeSet<>();
        for (Branch b : branches) {
            if (!allowed(sender, b.permission())) continue;
            int pos = 0;
            Arg current = null;
            boolean ok = true;
            for (Arg a : b.args()) {
                if (a.type().equals("text") || index < pos + a.width()) {
                    current = a;
                    break;
                }
                if (a.literal() && !raw[pos].equalsIgnoreCase(a.name())) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
                pos += a.width();
            }
            if (ok && current != null) suggest(current, prefix, out);
        }
        List<String> r = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String s : out) {
            if (s.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(prefix)) r.add(s);
            if (r.size() >= 80) break;
        }
        return r;
    }

    private static void suggest(Arg a, String prefix, TreeSet<String> out) {
        switch (a.type()) {
            case "literal" -> out.add(a.name());
            case "choice" -> out.addAll(a.choices());
            case "bool" -> {
                out.add("true");
                out.add("false");
            }
            case "player", "players", "entity", "entities" -> {
                for (Player p : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) out.add(p.getName());
                out.addAll(SELECTORS);
            }
            case "blockpos" -> out.add("~");
            case "item", "block" -> {
                if (prefix.length() < 1) return;
                for (Material m : Material.values()) {
                    if (m.isLegacy() || (a.type().equals("block") ? !m.isBlock() : !m.isItem())) continue;
                    String key = m.getKey().toString();
                    if (key.startsWith(prefix) || m.getKey().getKey().startsWith(prefix)) out.add(key);
                }
            }
            default -> {
            }
        }
    }
}
